status: targets frozen before treatment; validation driver pending
primary_environment: Linux x86_64, matching stock Bash 5.3 native artifacts, private homes and synthetic fixtures

qualification.primary_statistic: median of candidate/reference elapsed ratios in each run must be <=0.75
qualification.order: alternate candidate-first and reference-first by pair and run
qualification.failed_effect: fail whole run and retain every collected row; no replacement or pooling
qualification.preservation: unchanged original lifecycle/interactive/interpreter bars; no repeated >5% median or p95 regressions in applicable fields
qualification.separate_observation: instrumented diagnosis and process counts never enter elapsed qualification

observation.initialization: already-running interactive shell with prepared generation; initial activation outside primary interval
observation.identity: binary, interpreter, runtime/module, driver, configuration, input files and policy checked before/after each run
observation.resources: no persistent worker or cache authorized; transient watch data bounded by existing 128-path-per-plugin limit; record children/FDs/RSS separately with uncertainty
observation.tail_samples: retain per-command samples; do not infer typing p99 from this short corpus

cases.purpose: Activate useful Git shortcuts on demand in an existing shell and use them immediately
cases.load: event plugin, explicitly requested through binit load after initialization
cases.metadata_adapter: Declared no-op about-alias/url helpers; enabled-component query returns false; warning helper remains visible. No Git behavior is stubbed.
cases.primary_interval: wall time from requesting binit load through a later accepted command that uses alias g, calls get_default_branch and completes the effect assertions
effects: exact aliases and function definitions against same-interpreter direct-source control
g status --porcelain=v1 on a private local Git fixture
get_default_branch returns main for the declared local origin HEAD
ownership report complete for supported simple names
preexisting helpers and unrelated bindings preserved
post_interval_checks: owned unload preserves replacements and untracked non-simple alias names according to current contract
cases.limits: This improves activation frequency, not every subsequent Git command; no startup or unload time counts toward the target.

cases.purpose: Keep accepting ordinary commands while toolchain files are watched, then activate the ready plugin at its normal prompt boundary
cases.load: one watch plugin, eight absolute paths derived from fixture-relative names, condition based on ready marker

schedule.1-10: ordinary status-checked commands increment a checked counter; source remains zero
schedule.11: create build/toolchain.ready with ready newline; normal ensuing prompt must activate plugin
schedule.12: assert source count one and call ready function with literal/empty arguments; preserve return status37, export and current-shell directory effects
schedule.13: change settings.env to mode=ready newline; source must not run again
schedule.14-20: continue checked commands with source count one

cases.primary_interval: wall time through all20accepted command/prompt round trips, including activation and first ready-function use
effects: no source before declared readiness change
natural activation before command12 without explicit dispatch or forced load
literal arguments, status37, export and directory change
source count remains one after another watched-file change
caller options, unrelated function/alias and selection preserved
cases.limits: The fixture uses declared readiness markers; it does not claim to install or validate a real toolchain.
